description.value: PureBread is an artisan bakery originating in Whistler that has grown to multiple BC locations, including this Gastown outpost on West Hastings Street. It is known for freshly baked breads, pastries, and savoury treats, and has been featured in outlets such as the New York Times and Lonely Planet. For a touring cyclist passing through downtown Vancouver, it is a quality food stop within the Gastown neighbourhood.
